title: The Survivor's Cache
text: A cache hidden the way your House teaches, under a flat stone by a split tree: food wrapped in oilcloth, a dagger, a note in your House's cipher. The handwriting is shaky. The last line is pressed so hard it tore the paper.

outcomes.text: The note says where they went to ground, and what to beware.

options.label: Eat, and leave something in return.

outcomes.text: Strength for the road, and coin for them if they come back this way.

options.label: The Leader takes all of it.

outcomes.text: They will not need it if you find them first. That is what you tell yourselves.
